units.source_text: 这时先生已经坐起身，盘腿坐在缘台上了。

en.t: By this time Sensei had already sat up and was sitting cross-legged on the bench.

units.source_text: 先生说完，便用竹杖在地上画了一个圆圈，画完后，将竹杖笔直地戳在地上。

en.t: When Sensei finished speaking, he drew a circle on the ground with his bamboo cane, and after drawing it, he stuck the cane straight into the earth.

units.source_text: “不过，原来我可是个财主哪。”

en.t: Still, I used to be a man of property, you know.

units.source_text: 先生像是自言自语，所以我没能立刻接上话。

en.t: Sensei seemed to be talking to himself, so I could not immediately find a reply.

units.source_text: “原来我可是个财主哪。

en.t: I used to be a man of property, you know.

units.source_text: 你知道吗？”他又说了一遍，

en.t: Do you understand? he said again,

units.source_text: 然后瞧着我的脸露出了微笑。

en.t: and then he looked at my face and smiled.

units.source_text: 可我还是没有回答，

en.t: But even then I did not answer.

units.source_text: 其实是因为我笨嘴笨舌，不知该怎么回答。

en.t: In truth, I was too awkward with words and did not know how to respond.

units.source_text: 这时先生又转移了话题：

en.t: Then Sensei changed the subject again:

units.source_text: “后来，你父亲的病怎么样了？”

en.t: How has your father's illness been since then?

units.source_text: 说到父亲的病，过年以后我就毫无所知了。

en.t: As for my father's illness, I had known nothing about it since New Year's.

units.source_text: 每月跟家里的汇款一同寄来的短信，

en.t: The brief letters that came each month together with the money order from home

units.source_text: 虽然还是父亲写的，

en.t: were still written by my father,

units.source_text: 可是信里从未提及病情，

en.t: but they never mentioned his condition,

units.source_text: 而且，字迹也很工整，

en.t: and the handwriting was also quite steady,

units.source_text: 根本没有这类病人常见的颤抖和紊乱。

en.t: showing none of the trembling or disorder often seen in patients of that kind.

units.source_text: “信上什么也没有提，大概是好了吧。”

en.t: The letters do not say anything about it, so I suppose he must be better.

units.source_text: “但愿如此，不过，病到底是病啊。”

en.t: I hope so, but an illness is still an illness.

units.source_text: “看来彻底好是很难了吧，但眼下好像还过得去。

en.t: It seems a complete recovery may be difficult, but for now he appears to be getting by.

units.source_text: 信里什么也没有说。”

en.t: The letters do not say anything about it.

units.source_text: “是吗？”

en.t: Is that so?

units.source_text: 我把先生询问我家财产和父亲病情只当作是一般的闲聊，

en.t: I took Sensei's questions about my family's property and my father's illness as ordinary small talk,

units.source_text: 随便问问。

en.t: asked casually in passing.

units.source_text: 但是先生的话音里，却有着把这两者联系起来的意思，

en.t: But in Sensei's tone there was a meaning that linked the two together,

units.source_text: 我没有先生的亲身感受，当然不会意识到这一点。

en.t: and since I did not share Sensei's own experience, of course I could not realize it.
